en: Fixed Bash commands the permission checker cannot fully analyze skipping the prompt under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`, and a subshell hiding a dangerous `rm` in bypass mode
zh: 修复在 `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` 下，权限检查器无法完全分析的 Bash 命令跳过权限提示的问题，以及绕过模式下子 shell 隐藏危险 `rm` 的问题
